name: Asian Tigers Mobility
summary: Regional moving and relocation brand frequently used on corporate packages — useful when GST relief paperwork and condo lift bookings matter as much as the crate.
body: International movers differ wildly on inventory care, storage, and Singapore Customs paperwork. Ask explicitly who files the Declaration of Facts and TradeNet GST-relief permit before the Bill of Lading lands — late DOFs are a common reason courier/freight holds bill GST on used personal effects. Get two to three like-for-like quotes on the same inventory, confirm insurance valuation, and align shipment timing with housing keys and condo move-in slots, not only with your flight. For later intra-island shifts of the same household, many families switch to lighter local movers once the ocean freight chapter closes — still coordinate MCST lift padding and deposits. Pair with the shipping-household and moving-within-Singapore guides.
whenToEngage: Corporate or self-managed inbound ocean freight
Need Customs DOF / GST-relief ownership clarity
Aligning shipment with condo lift slots
